youtube_transcript: Episode eleven is where Voidwalker Academy finally stops teaching and starts testing. Kaiden walks into the Rite of Descent convinced he can hold the tether on his own, and Sera is the only one who tells him the truth about what the void does to a first-year. Instructor Vance lets him go anyway, because that is the entire point of the Rite, and when the tether snaps it is Sera who goes in after him. They both come back changed, and the Academy pretends not to notice. Like the video, leave a comment with what you think the void showed Kaiden, and subscribe so you do not miss the finale.
plot_points: Kaiden enters the Rite of Descent believing he can hold the tether unaided.
Sera warns Kaiden about what the void does to first-year students.
Instructor Vance allows the attempt to proceed as a deliberate lesson.
The tether snaps and Sera descends into the void to retrieve Kaiden.
Both students return altered while the Academy refuses to acknowledge it.
